001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SharedTrigger;
016
017public class MinnowGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
018        
019        @Override
020        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
021                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
022                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
023                
024                // not inside slipstreams, but can be close enough so they occasionally dart in
025                Vector2f loc = findHyperspaceArea(pf.getLocation(), 1500f, 2000f, 1000f, manager.getRandom(), true, 250f);
026                if (loc == null) return null;
027                
028                SectorEntityToken target = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(loc); 
029                
030                int numMinnows = 5 + manager.getRandom().nextInt(11);
031                
032                float minRange = 100f;
033                float maxRange = 500;
034                float dur = 5f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 5f;
035                
036                SharedTrigger trigger = new SharedTrigger();
037                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
038                for (int i = 0; i < numMinnows; i++) {
039                        MinnowGhost m = new MinnowGhost(manager, target, minRange, maxRange,
040                                                                        dur + manager.getRandom().nextFloat(), trigger);
041                        result.add(m);
042                }
043                return result;
044        }
045
046        
047        @Override
048        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
049                return GhostFrequencies.getMinnowFrequency(manager);
050                //return 10000f;
051        }
052        
053        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInOrNearSlipstream() {
054                return true;
055        }
056}
